## Strategy
The external-grounding requirement is met by workspace provider record DOI `10.1112/jlms.12832`: its abstract states “We prove the minimality conjecture. Our proof uses the Hopf algebra structure of the ring of symmetric functions.” [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 124-131].

No task-owned sandbox execution or persisted-source resolver manifest is supplied here. Therefore no literal counts, code, execution record, or artifact can be validly produced.

## Gaps
The exact audit certificate is not established. Missing: resolution of all three requested persisted IDs to byte streams; executable code; input/output and artifact digests; twelve counts; complete stdout/stderr; exit status; and inspectable task-owned output locator.

## Next
A task-owned sandbox action must execute the specified UTF-8, case-sensitive overlapping-literal audit over exactly the three requested IDs and persist the complete required artifact. No parent-theorem claim follows.
